title: Long-term Progression of Patients Treated and Monitored for Relapsed or Refractory Ph+ ALL
official: Retrospective Study of the Long-term Progression of Patients Treated and Monitored for Relapsed or Refractory Ph+ ALL
summary: The objective of this retrospective study is to examine the outcome of patients who relapse with Ph+ ALL and to potentially identify response profiles in order toadvance the treatment regimens that can be offered.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>= 18
* Relapse or refractory Ph1 ALL

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
sponsor: Group for Research in Adult Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
